result.reason: The operative language substantially reaches the preferred position: it provides a mutual cap with a $1 million floor, a mutual consequential-damages exclusion, all required uncapped carve-outs, and an exception for the Company's payment obligations. It adds only the missing liability regime and leaves unrelated language unchanged. Drafting quality is reduced because the cap uses all “amounts” rather than specifically fees, anchors the lookback to the event rather than the claim, and places Section 9A after the Section 10 heading.
